import java.util.*;
import java.lang.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Codechef {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        sc.nextLine();
        String st = sc.nextLine();

        List<String> outsideParts = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> insideParts = new ArrayList<>();

        int i = 0;
        int j = 0;

        while (i < st.lastIndexOf(')')) {
            int open = st.indexOf('(', i);
            outsideParts.add(st.substring(j, open));

            j = st.indexOf(')', j + 1) + 1;
            int close = st.indexOf(')', i + 1);
            insideParts.add(st.substring(open + 1, close));

            i = close;
        }

        outsideParts.add(st.substring(j));

        int maxl = 0;
        int cnt = 0;

        for (String part : outsideParts) {
            StringTokenizer tok = new StringTokenizer(part, "_");
            while (tok.hasMoreTokens()) {
                int l = tok.nextToken().length();
                if (l > maxl) {
                    maxl = l;
                }
            }
        }

        for (String part : insideParts) {
            StringTokenizer tok = new StringTokenizer(part, "_");
            while (tok.hasMoreTokens()) {
                tok.nextToken();
                cnt++;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxl + " " + cnt);
    }
}

import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;

public class Codechef {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        sc.nextLine();
        String st = sc.nextLine();

        Pattern token = Pattern.compile("[^_]+");
        int maxl = 0;
        int cnt = 0;
        int i = 0;
        int j = 0;

        while (i < st.lastIndexOf(')')) {
            int open = st.indexOf('(', i);
            maxl = scan(st.substring(j, open), token, maxl, false);

            j = st.indexOf(')', j + 1) + 1;
            int close = st.indexOf(')', i + 1);
            cnt += scan(st.substring(open + 1, close), token, 0, true);

            i = close;
        }

        maxl = scan(st.substring(j), token, maxl, false);
        System.out.println(maxl + " " + cnt);
    }

    private static int scan(String text, Pattern token, int acc, boolean count) {
        Matcher m = token.matcher(text);
        while (m.find()) {
            if (count) {
                acc++;
            } else {
                int l = m.group().length();
                if (l > acc) {
                    acc = l;
                }
            }
        }
        return acc;
    }
}

import java.util.*;
import java.lang.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Codechef {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {

        sc.nextLine();
        String st = sc.nextLine();

        int maxl = 0;
        int cnt = 0;
        int i = 0;
        int j = 0;

        while (i < st.lastIndexOf(')')) {
            int open = st.indexOf('(', i);

            int best = Arrays.stream(st.substring(j, open).split("_", -1))
                    .filter(t -> !t.isEmpty())
                    .mapToInt(String::length)
                    .max()
                    .orElse(0);
            if (best > maxl) {
                maxl = best;
            }

            j = st.indexOf(')', j + 1) + 1;
            int close = st.indexOf(')', i + 1);

            cnt += (int) Arrays.stream(st.substring(open + 1, close).split("_", -1))
                    .filter(t -> !t.isEmpty())
                    .count();

            i = close;
        }

        int best = Arrays.stream(st.substring(j).split("_", -1))
                .filter(t -> !t.isEmpty())
                .mapToInt(String::length)
                .max()
                .orElse(0);
        if (best > maxl) {
            maxl = best;
        }

        System.out.println(maxl + " " + cnt);
    }
}
